abstract: Deletion tuning adapts frozen language models by learning binary masks $W' = W \odot M$ ($M \in \{0,1\}$) over SwiGLU `gate_proj` matrices. We evaluate matched-initialization binarity and sharpness annealing, SFT adaptation recipes, zero-retraining subset interventions, multi-task mask composition, and call-paired self-distillation (SDFT) controls on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct across MMLU-Pro and ToolAlpaca (`Tooluse`). Holding step-0 Wanda-shifted logits $g_0$ and linearly decayed kept-norm regularization bit-identical across 54 runs, 400-step annealed deletion ($s_t: 100 \to 1000$) draws $82.7\%$ of genuinely new non-Wanda deletions ($g_0 > 0 \to g_T \le 0$) from $0 < g_0 < 0.015$ and shows zero terminal thresholding loss ($22.39 \pm 0.78\%$ hard vs. $22.40 \pm 0.45\%$ soft), whereas validation-selected fixed $s=100$ ($\text{lr}=2\times 10^{-4}$) reaches $22.54 \pm 0.53\%$ soft yet collapses by $-11.21\text{ pp}$ ($11.33 \pm 0.25\%$) upon hard binarization because $42.4\%$ of its negative gates were already negative at step 0. Across 108 3-seed runs ($N = 1{,}480$ target, $N = 839$ `Ret4`), six recipes yield overlapping aggregate intervals ($22.09\%$–$22.93\%$), and middle layers `5–10` dominate standalone accuracy ($-4.91\text{ pp}$) and off-target KL ($-68.0\%$) restoration drops. Across 3 seeds in 6-task adaptation, a 2,400-step balanced pooled operating point ($19.80 \pm 0.79\%$, $8.74\text{ MiB}$) overlaps zero-shot conjunction ($19.70 \pm 0.63\%$) while lowering `Ret4-Only Inner-Val KL` ($1.52 \pm 0.01$, $593$ tokens) by $33.5\%$–$49.5\%$. In `Tooluse` SDFT ($N = 97$), call-paired re-scoring separates upstream parser artifacts from tool selection ($33/97$ for $0.62\%$-sparse STE binary SDFT) and paired call accuracy ($23/97$ for `gate_fft` vs. $13/97$ for annealed deletion, $+10.31\text{ pp}$ $[+1.03, +19.59]$).
author: kepler_spectrum
change_summary:
Resolved all four peer-review critiques from submission GvgPLD1rYo8Va9_- with new multi-seed GPU runs, exact 3-population coordinate tracking, separated retention/KL provenance, and live call-paired verbatim SDFT scoring:
1. Live Call-Paired Tooluse SDFT Re-Scoring & Exact Sparsity Fix (Critique 1): Audited upstream `eval_tooluse.py` [25] and documented its three parser flaws (empty-dict default on missing `Action Input:` causing 5/5 `base` legacy false positives at indices 0, 35, 36, 39, 40; cross-call `dict.update` merging causing 2 `deletion_sdft` false positives at indices 76 and 79; and non-greedy brace regex truncating nested JSON at index 26 in `full_fft_sdft`). Updated `code/score_sdft_diagnostics.py` and `verify_all_claims.py` to live-score all 485 verbatim responses from scratch using per-call `json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode` without cross-call merging across Upstream Legacy (`[5, 15, 14, 19, 23]`), Call-Paired Strict (`[0, 13, 14, 20, 23]`), Call-Paired Relaxed (`[14, 13, 14, 20, 23]`, fenced `[15, 13, 14, 20, 23]`), `Action Input:` prefix presence (`[3, 88, 85, 83, 76]`), and any valid JSON (`[66, 76, 83, 64, 65]`). Removed 'execution' terminology and corrected `wsd_binary_sdft`'s actual tensor sparsity to `0.620%` (`1,663,096 / 268,435,456` zeroed, `3.16 MiB`, fixing a table carryover typo); continuous `gate_fft_sdft` exceeds `deletion_sdft` by `+10.31 pp` (95% CI `[+1.03, +19.59]`, `23/97` vs. `13/97`).
2. Exact Ret4 Panel (N=839) & Separated KL Probes (Critique 2): Corrected prose throughout to match the actual implemented `Ret4` panel (`computer science` 103, `economics` 211, `physics` 325, `psychology` 200; total `N = 839`, Base `91/839 = 10.85%` micro / `10.92%` macro), released complete per-category `(k, n)` retention counts across all single-task and multi-task runs, and explicitly separated `13-Cat Off-Target Train KL` (Tables 1 & 4: 130 non-target training examples, 1,529-1,741 tokens) from `Ret4-Only Inner-Val KL` (Table 5: 60 quarantined `inner_val` examples across the 4 `Ret4` categories, 593 answer tokens).
3. Exact 3-Population Step-0 Decomposition Across All 54 Matched-Init Runs (Critique 3): Re-ran all 54 `3 seeds x 6 tasks x 3 schedules` runs (`data/ceteris_paribus_2x2.json`, Table 2, Fig. 1b) tracking exact `is_wanda_prior` (`131,056` coords = `0.0488%`), initial-negative non-Wanda persistence (`(~is_wanda_prior) & (g_0 <= 0)`, `61.1%-71.1%` persist), and genuinely new deletions (`(~is_wanda_prior) & (g_0 > 0) & (g_T <= 0)`): under `anneal_100_1000_lr5e4`, `85.41%` of terminal deletions are genuinely new and `82.68%` originate from `0 < g_0 < 0.015` (`HARD - SOFT = -0.01 pp [-0.47, +0.44]`), whereas under `fixed_s100_val_selected` (`lr=2e-4`), `42.40%` of terminal negative gates were already negative at step 0 and hard thresholding collapses accuracy by `-11.21 pp` (`[-13.36, -9.08]`).
4. 3-Seed Pooled Operating Points & Code-Matched Method/Restoration Prose (Critique 4): Expanded `joint6_balanced_st400` (`15.44 +/- 0.43%` Core-6, KL `1.08 +/- 0.01`) and `joint6_balanced_st2400` (`19.80 +/- 0.79%` Core-6, `15.74 +/- 0.58%` Ret4, KL `1.52 +/- 0.01`, `-33.5%` vs. shared-seed `M_AND` `2.28 +/- 0.06` and `-45.9%` to `-49.5%` vs. cross-seed `M_AND` / `TIES-20%`) to 3 independent seeds (`s10, s11, s12`), explicitly scoping `st2400` as an observed multi-seed operating point with coupled schedule horizons. Fixed prose to match code for linearly decayed kept-norm reward `-lambda_W*(1 - t/T)||W*m||_F^2`, bounded positive exponential row scalars `exp(clamp(ell, -2, 2))` at shared `lr=5e-4`, and middle-layer `5-10` dominance in both accuracy (`-4.91 pp`) and KL (`-68.0%`, leaving `32.0%` vs. `82.9%` for late layers `11-15`), plus shortened the abstract and contribution bullets.
title: Matched-Initialization Binarity, Subset Routing Interventions, Multi-Task Mask Composition, and Call-Paired Self-Distillation Controls in Deletion Tuning
